revisions.prompt:
Create ONE complete animation sprite atlas for an original 2D anime arcade fighting game. Exactly FOUR COLUMNS and SIX ROWS = 24 full-body sprites in a uniform invisible grid, portrait canvas 2:3 (ideally 1024x1536). Use REAL TRANSPARENT RGBA background outside silhouettes. Do not paint colored lighting, scenery, ground shadow, frame borders, grid lines, labels or text. Fixed side-on three-quarter camera. ALL sprites face SCREEN RIGHT, except torso rotation within punches; no camera changes. Each cell has the SAME character scale, foot baseline at 90% of cell height, generous 10% side padding, complete horns/hair/tail/shoes. No cross-cell overlap. Clean cel shading, bold dark outlines, 3-head-tall chibi proportions matching identity reference. Each ROW is a FOUR-FRAME SEQUENCE read left-to-right; consecutive frames must change limb positions coherently, not be duplicates. Row1 RUN LOOP: left leg reaching right arm forward; both legs passing under hips; right leg reaching left arm forward; airborne push-off back leg extended. Row2 JAB: fist drawn beside cheek and torso wound back; leading arm fully punches right; extended fist follows through with forward weight; fist retracts back to guard. Row3 SECOND PUNCH: rear elbow cocked with hips turning back; strong bent-elbow hook toward right with torso pivot; back/shoulder rotates through following the punch; hips and arms return to ready. Row4 SIDE KICK: knee chambered high with both hands guarding; leg shoots horizontally right with supporting foot planted; extended leg and torso follow through; knee retracts before foot returns to floor. Row5 UPPERCUT: deep crouch fist beside hip; legs extend and fist rises vertically above head; airborne upward follow-through with knee raised; descending recovery knees ready to absorb landing. Row6 HIT AND RECOVERY: backward standing recoil from punch eyes squeezed shut; feet swept out falling backward; lying on side on floor head left feet right at same body scale; getting up on one knee, one hand supporting ground. No energy effects or extra props. Readable silhouette, clearly distinct anticipation/contact/follow-through/recovery. Preserve outfit details through all 24 sprites.
